units.source_text: 我常常坐在礁石上看书。

en.t: I often sat on the rocks and read.

units.source_text: K往往什么也不干，只是默默地坐着。

en.t: K usually did nothing; he simply sat there in silence.

units.source_text: 我完全猜不透他是在沉思，还是在眺望美景，或是在描绘美好的未来。

en.t: I could not tell at all whether he was lost in thought, gazing at the scenery, or imagining a bright future.

units.source_text: 我不时抬起头问他在想什么，他只回答一句‘没想什么’。

en.t: From time to time I raised my head and asked what he was thinking, but he only answered, "Nothing."

units.source_text: 我常常幻想，如果这样静静地坐在自己身旁的人，不是K而是小姐的话，那该多幸福啊！

en.t: I often imagined how happy I would be if the person sitting quietly beside me like that were not K but the young lady.

units.source_text: 只是这样想想倒也没什么，

en.t: There was nothing wrong with merely thinking that,

units.source_text: 可有时我又忽然心生猜疑，他是不是也怀着同我一样的期望坐在岩石上呢？

en.t: but at times I would suddenly grow suspicious and wonder whether he too was sitting on the rocks with the same hopes as mine.

units.source_text: 于是，我突然对坐在这儿平静地看书厌烦起来。

en.t: Then I suddenly became tired of sitting there calmly reading.

units.source_text: 我猛地站起来，然后无所顾忌地大声喊叫起来，

en.t: I sprang to my feet and began shouting loudly without restraint,

units.source_text: 我哪里还有心情优雅地吟诵那些诗啦，和歌什么的，

en.t: I had no mood left to recite poems or waka with elegance,

units.source_text: 只是像野蛮人一般扯着嗓子乱叫唤。

en.t: but only yelled at the top of my voice like a savage.

units.source_text: 有一次，我突然从背后猛地揪住K的衣领，

en.t: Once, I suddenly grabbed K by the collar from behind,

units.source_text: 对他说道：‘把你推到海里去，你怎么办？’

en.t: and said to him, "What would you do if I pushed you into the sea?"

units.source_text: K依旧一动不动地坐着，背对着我答道：‘正合我意啊，推吧。’

en.t: K remained seated without moving, and with his back to me he answered, "That would suit me. Go ahead and push."

units.source_text: 我立刻把揪着他衣领的手松开了。

en.t: I immediately let go of the hand with which I had been gripping his collar.
